description: Branch R-FMT-2 Scalar boundaries (admission, coercion, rounding) on a MDB. SB(ID Long, Fb Byte, Fi Integer, Fl Long, Fs Single, Fd Double), one value per row through a table recordset, each write with a marked Errors read. Fractions and out-of-range values: Byte 0.5, 1.5, 2.5, 255.4, 255.5, -0.4, -0.5; Integer -32769, 32768, 32767.4, 32767.5, -32768.5, -32768.6; Long 2147483647.4, 2147483647.5, 2147483648, -2147483648.5, -2147483648.6, 1.5, 2.5, 3.5 (all VT_R8); Single 3.4028235E38, 3.5E38, 1E-46, 1E-45, -3.5E38; Double 1.7976931348623157E308 and the BSTR text 1e309, -1e309, 5e-325. Asks the rounding rule of fractional input (half to even or half away), which side of each range is refused, and what an overflow stores.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
